data = open('/app/vulnerable','rb').read()

while data[i] != 0x42:

    i += 1
flag = blob.decode()
print("offset=0x%x" % i)
print("FLAG=" + flag)
open('/app/results.txt','w').write(flag + "\n")
EOF
